notes_blind_original: The report states 'There was no attempt to make random number generation reproducible (e.g. with the set.seed() function)'. 'Major Deviations in Results: We were unable to replicate ... Supplementary Table 20.' I confirmed directly that KSS_data.csv (figshare 23578698, Data.zip) has columns PB_No, appointment, condition, KSS_value, KSS_no, gender, with no 'time' column, while BlumeC_NHB_KSS.R at the pinned commit filters on time == 'Evening_1'. The report itself is inconsistent for the KSS interaction (text 0.11/0.05 vs Table 1 0.01 'matched'). Paper-level status is 'computational issues' because KSS outputs and Supp Table 20 did not recur, while the primary claim (C3) did.
